-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- S→N Phase 1 SELECT: brands needing INSERT or UPDATE in Notion
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- INSERT path: notion_id IS NULL (never synced)
-- UPDATE path: updated_at > notion_synced_at (Supabase changed since last sync)
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SELECT
  id, brand_slug, brand_name, fingerprint, fingerprint_display_name,
  status, brand_structure, notion_workspace,
  company, brand_description, brand_web_url, gsc_property_url,
  ga4_property_id, positioning_mode, compliance_profile,
  cloudflare_account_email, notion_id,
  CASE WHEN notion_id IS NULL THEN 'insert' ELSE 'update' END AS sync_op
FROM brands
WHERE notion_workspace IN ('vt_intelligence', 'the_gifted_synapse')
  AND (
    notion_id IS NULL
    OR (notion_id IS NOT NULL 
        AND notion_synced_at IS NOT NULL 
        AND updated_at > notion_synced_at)
  )
LIMIT 20;

-- Error log → seo_data_quality_metrics
INSERT INTO seo_data_quality_metrics
  (metric_name, metric_category, metric_value_jsonb, status, target_table_name, scope_description, computed_at)
VALUES
  ('notion_sync_error', 'sync_lag',
   $1::jsonb,
   'red',
   'brands',
   $2,
   NOW())
RETURNING id;
